The BMW 507 roadster, styled by Albrecht von Goertz, is among the most beautiful BMWs ever made — Elvis Presley owned one. Its 3.2-liter V8 was BMW's first. Only 252 were built; the car's high cost nearly bankrupted BMW, making survivors extraordinarily valuable today. Baseline facts: German roadster 1956-1959; 252 built by BMW; Elvis Presley's car..
